records.context: one row per cell with any read: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (exact or corrected), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (distinct callable barcodes), ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` and ``level`` of the top barcode (empty unless ``perfect`` or ``great``), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (of matched reads), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` and ``quality``. With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.

records.source: one row per cell with any read: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (exact or corrected), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (distinct callable barcodes), ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` and ``level`` of the top barcode (empty unless ``perfect`` or ``great``), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (of matched reads), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` and ``quality``. With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.
records.translation: 每个有任意读数的细胞一行：``keys``、``reads``、``matched``（精确或已校正）、``exact``、``corrected``、``ambiguous``、``collision``、``out_of_library``、``barcodes``（不同的可判定条形码）、排名第一条形码的 ``prefix``、``guide``、``gene`` 和 ``level``（除非为 ``perfect`` 或 ``great``，否则为空）、``top_reads``、``top_exact``、``top_share``（占匹配读数的比例）、``second_reads``、``has_exact_read`` 和 ``quality``。当 ``minority_min_reads`` 为 2 或更大时，``barcodes``、``second_reads`` 和等级只计入规则保留的读数，并增加两列：``minority_ignored``（被排除的读数）和 ``minority_rescued``（仅因该规则而被判定的细胞为 True）。在 ``'weighted_majority'``（:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`）下，排名第一的条形码是权重最大的条形码，并增加五列。``weight_top`` 和 ``weight_total`` 分别是排名第一条形码和该细胞的读数权重之和。``d_weight_top`` 是排名第一条形码各读数的距离项之和，``g_median_top`` 是这些读数到细胞核距离的中位数（没有距离时为 NaN）。``bleed_discounted`` 统计被邻近折减降低权重的条形码数。
